title: Galloping robot "WildCat"
content: Boston Dynamics has introduced its latest animal-like robot called WildCat, a galloping, bounding robot that looks a bit like an organic quadriped, but has a terrifying energy and geometry all its own.Mech artists, note how the design conserves most of the mass toward the center of the form, with no heavy forms at the periphery.
